name: Takahashi Yuka
source: A goofy, simple-minded character who doesn't think about anything. The client is a famous S&M club owner. Having taken action upon S&M club's manager's sweet words "if you can become a first class M woman, you'll earn a lot on money.", she came to the mansion nonchalantly.
